name: sgh-connect
description: SGH Connect — Sistema Integrado de Gestão Hospitalar (monólito modular)

scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run prisma:deploy -w @sgh/api
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed -w @sgh/api
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @sgh/api" "npm run dev -w @sgh/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w @sgh/shared && npm test -w @sgh/api && npm run test:e2e -w @sgh/api && npm test -w @sgh/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && npm test -w @sgh/shared && npm test -w @sgh/api && npm test -w @sgh/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @sgh/api && npm run build -w @sgh/web
